question: How is the supreme principle Shiva conceived at the highest limit?
premises: At the end of all levels stands a supreme principle.
This principle is beyond all coverings, all-pervading, independent, and all-knowing.
This conceived principle is identified as Shiva.
inference: Even the highest conceptualized Shiva is imagined as a supreme, free, omniscient, all-pervading reality beyond all coverings.
uncertainties: yāvadante could be read as 'at the end of everything' or more specifically 'at the end of the sequence of principles'.
plain_english: At the final limit, one conceives a supreme principle beyond all coverings, all-pervading, independent, all-knowing, and called Shiva.
